title: Te Kaitono o te Wāhi Tapu
intro: I ngā hāora marino o te pō, ka karanga tetahi wairua pono ki te Atua Aroha i roto i ngā pakitara tapu o te wāhi tapu. Kua tata ngā tau o te whakapono me te manawanui korekore ki te utu i tētahi merekara e kawe mai ai i te hari me te taonga tuku iho o te poropititanga.
clues: I whakapau ahau i ōku rā me ōku pō i roto i te karakia i roto i te wāhi tapu, e inoi tonu ana ki tōku Ariki.
I koroheke ahau, ā, he pakoko taku wahine; heoi, kāore i ngaro taku tumanako ki te aroha noa o Allah.
I homai ki ahau he tama, ko Yahya tōna ingoa, ā, i riro ia hei poropiti, hei tohu hoki mō te tika.
He poropiti anō hoki ahau, i tonoa mai hei arahi i ngā Tamariki a Iharaira.
He uri ahau nō te Poropiti a Haruna, ā, i mahi ahau hei tohunga i roto i te Temepara.
I tukua mai ki ahau te tiaki i a Meriama, te whaea o Īha, ā, i kite ahau i ana merekara.
